helpTitle: Caribbean Draw Poker (exchange up to 2 cards)
helpPlay: p                    call (place play bet equal to 2x ante)
hintPairOrBetter: you have one pair or better
hintAceKingHigh: no made hand, but you hold an Ace and a King
hintWeakHand: no made hand and nothing as high as Ace-King
helpExampleBet: b 10                 ante 10 and get a hand
helpExamplePlay: p                    call, placing a play bet of 2x the ante
jackpotHelp: Jackpot (optional): pays on a flush or better, whether or not you beat the dealer
drawHelp: You may exchange up to {{max}} card(s) for a fee of {{cost}}. `d 1 3` swaps the 1st and 3rd; a bare `d` stands pat.
hintStandPat: Stand pat: you already hold a made hand
hintDrawWeak: Consider drawing: no made hand — discard what you cannot use and go for one
helpDraw: d [n...]             exchange up to 2 cards (for a fee); bare d stands pat
